rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for going back to a place or person, especially when the destination is understood as over there.

example.english: I will return to your place tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 faan1 heoi3 nei5 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this for a ticket that includes travel out and back, rather than a one-way ticket.

example.english: I want to buy a return ticket, so I won't have to buy another one.
example.traditional: 我想買張來回票，唔使再買多次。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zoeng1 loi4 wui4 piu3 m4 sai2 zoi3 maai5 do1 ci3

rows.note: Use 畀返 when giving an item back to its original owner or holder.

example.english: I need to return the book to the library after reading it.
example.traditional: 本書睇完要畀返圖書館。
example.jyutping: bun2 syu1 tai2 jyun4 jiu3 bei2 faan1 tou4 syu1 gun2

rows.note: Use this for goods sent back to a seller, usually because they are defective or unwanted.

example.english: This shirt has a problem, so I want to return it.
example.traditional: 呢件衫有問題，我要退貨。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 man6 tai4 ngo5 jiu3 teoi3 fo3

rows.note: Use this for the gain or loss produced by an investment, as in 投資回報.

example.english: The return on this investment is pretty good.
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 tau4 zi1 ge3 wui4 bou3 m4 co3

rows.note: Use this when putting something back in its former place.

example.english: Remember to return the tools to the drawer after using them.
example.traditional: 用完啲工具記得放返去櫃桶。
example.jyutping: jung6 jyun4 di1 gung1 geoi6 gei3 dak1 fong3 faan1 heoi3 gwai6 tung2

rows.note: Use this for replying to someone or getting back to them by message or phone.

example.english: I’ll return your call after lunch.
example.traditional: 我食完晏就覆返你電話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 aan3 zau6 fuk1 faan1 nei5 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this for the form or report submitted to the government declaring income for tax purposes.

example.english: I've filled out the tax return and will submit it to the tax office tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我已經填好份報稅表，聽日交畀稅局。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tin4 hou2 fan6 bou3 seoi3 biu2 ting1 jat6 gaau1 bei2 seoi3 guk6
